title: React Router Applied Check
description: Practice routing setup, URL params, nested route layout, navigation side effects, protected routes, and loader-aware decisions.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: A server returns 404 when the user refreshes /dashboard in a SPA. What is likely missing?

options.text: Server fallback support that serves the app for client routes

questions.explanation: Client-side routes still need server configuration so direct URL requests load the app shell.

questions.prompt: A products page supports /products?sort=price&page=2. What state is this best suited for?
questions.explanation: Shareable, bookmarkable filters and paging commonly belong in query strings.

questions.prompt: When building nested settings routes, which choices are usually correct? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Render an Outlet in the parent layout
Use relative child paths where appropriate
Use index routes for default child content
Duplicate the full layout in every child route

questions.explanation: Nested routes share parent layout through Outlet and can define relative and index children.

questions.prompt: A component calls navigate("/login") directly during render when user is missing. What is better?

options.text: Render a Navigate element or navigate from an effect/event flow as appropriate

questions.explanation: Navigation is a side effect; declarative redirects or effect/event-driven navigation avoid render side effects.

questions.prompt: After login, you want to return users to the protected page they originally requested. What should you preserve?

options.text: The intended destination in location state or a safe return URL
The user password in the URL

questions.explanation: Protected route flows often save the attempted location and navigate back after authentication.

questions.prompt: A protected route should show a loading state while authentication status is still unknown.
questions.explanation: Redirecting before auth state loads can incorrectly send logged-in users away.

questions.prompt: Which are common route parameter pitfalls? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Not refetching when a parameter changes
Using query strings for every required path identity

questions.explanation: Params are strings, param changes should update dependent work, and path vs query choice matters.

questions.prompt: A route needs data before rendering and the app uses React Router data APIs. What may be better than fetching in a component effect?
questions.explanation: Loaders can align data fetching with route matching and navigation in data-router apps.
